sections.body: Food gives your body energy to grow, play and think.
A balanced plate has lots of fruit and vegetables. About half the plate! 🥕🍎
It also has grains like rice, bread or roti 🍚, and protein like beans, eggs, fish or meat 🥚.
Water is the best drink. Sweets and fizzy drinks are 'sometimes' foods.
Draw your dinner plate. Is half of it fruit and vegetables?
Families eat in many ways (vegetarian, halal, kosher and more). Every way can be balanced. Avoid calling foods 'bad'; 'sometimes foods' is kinder and more accurate.

quiz.q: About how much of a balanced plate should be fruit and vegetables?
hints: It's a big part of the plate.
If a pizza is cut in 2 equal parts, each part is a half. How much plate do fruit and veggies get?
quiz.explain: About half the plate should be fruit and vegetables.

quiz.q: What is the best drink for your body?
hints: It comes from the tap or a bottle and is clear.
Plants need it to grow, and so do you!
quiz.explain: Water is the best drink. It has no sugar.

hints: Protein foods help build muscles. They come from animals, or from plant seeds and pods.
Lentils and chickpeas are protein foods from plants. Which option is most like them?
